arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in textkit/slug.py by collapsing consecutive hyphens into one (`re.sub(r"-{2,}", "-", ...)`) and stripping leading/trailing hyphens (`.strip("-")`) after the existing non-alphanumeric replacement. This makes `slugify("Hello,  World!")` return `"hello-world"` and `slugify("--a--b--")` return `"a-b"`, without changing the public signature. All tests pass.
